title: Physical road flow; excludes virtual movement arcs; static model PCE, not counts
caption: Saved physical-link PCE for 11:00–12:00 HBO_LOCAL_ACTIVITY. Only physical road geometry is drawn; virtual movement arcs are excluded. Color is log(1 + PCE), with the legend labelled in PCE per period. OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Model output, not observed traffic. The frozen OSM source segments each have two endpoints; the map preserves those straight source segments. Demand covers 7.501778 km² while road support covers 13.235585 km². Single-pass engineering scenario; no local empirical calibration.
